recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間的造血組織被發炎細胞取代，其間可見數個邊界清楚、淡染的圓形上皮樣組織球結節（epithelioid granulomas），這就是骨髓肉芽腫的線索。
features: Multiple discrete, round, pale-staining nodules composed of epithelioid histiocytes within the intertrabecular space
Surrounding marrow replaced by a mixed inflammatory infiltrate with loss of normal fat and trilineage architecture
No definite central caseous necrosis identified at this low magnification
Bony trabeculae with fragmentation and tissue separation (processing artifact)
Low-power view limits assessment of giant cells and organisms
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy sections at low power show bony trabeculae with intertrabecular spaces largely occupied by a mixed inflammatory infiltrate. Several discrete, well-circumscribed, pale epithelioid histiocytic aggregates consistent with granulomas are present. No definite caseating necrosis is seen at this magnification, and normal fat and hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced in the involved areas. Correlation with special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, cultures, and clinical/serologic workup is required. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation of the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Lipogranulomas are small, contain fat vacuoles with scattered histiocytes and lymphocytes, and are incidental, whereas these are larger compact epithelioid granulomas within an inflamed marrow.
Hodgkin involvement shows Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic polymorphous background (CD30+/CD15+), not discrete epithelioid granulomas alone.
Infectious granulomas may be morphologically identical and are distinguished by AFB/GMS/PAS stains, cultures, and PCR, with necrosis favoring infection.
Mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular/perivascular spindle-cell infiltrates with eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive, unlike epithelioid histiocytes.
